creativeDirection.summary: A welcoming cultural organization site with clear service information, strong editorial scale, and restrained red accents. Keep the existing identity recognizable.

traits.boundary: not sparse enough to obscure useful details
not decorated with generic cultural motifs

creativeDirection.productiveTension: Large editorial headings and prominent media composition paired with scannable catalog details and predictable controls.

signatureDevice.description: Small square markers beside section labels, adapted from the square markers in the Sidrano process reference.
invariants: Keep the square simple and consistently sized.
Use red for the marker and primary actions.
Do not replace the U monogram or repeat the marker as decoration on every card.

creativeDirection.restraint: Let spacing, type, and admin-managed media define the page. Use cards only for coherent service, catalog, or news items.
avoid: Copying reference logos, names, or distinctive palettes.
Inventing organization facts, pricing, availability, testimonials, or outcomes.
Adding decorative icons, repeated grid lines, or ornamental diagrams without a clear purpose.

interfaceDirection: Use an 8px spacing rhythm, the existing maximum content width of 1160px, and the existing 20px radius. Follow the references' generous section spacing and clear hierarchy while keeping service, catalog, and news details easy to scan. Use cream as the page canvas and white for coherent interactive or comparable units. Keep shadows subtle and avoid repeated borders. Use red for primary actions, keyboard focus, selected states, and one recurring service or media treatment. Keep controls familiar with clear hover, focus, active, and disabled states. Adapt large headings and media-led compositions to mobile without squeezing text or hiding details.

imageDirection.summary: Preserve the existing media slots and their geometry for later admin uploads. Follow the references' prominent framed media and responsive crops without requiring new imagery.
subjects: Existing dance service and BRT catalog media slots
imageDirection.treatment: Keep related media proportions and frames consistent. Preserve space when a slot is empty to prevent layout shifts when admins upload images. On mobile, use full-width media frames and readable content order.
avoid: Treating empty admin slots as assets that must be sourced or generated.
Using reference screenshots as site imagery.
Using decorative SVGs or diagrams instead of meaningful photography or product images.

motionDirection.summary: Use visible motion to clarify hierarchy and continuity while keeping content readable if motion is unavailable or reduced.
principles: Purpose: introduce the page; trigger: initial load; affected relationship: reveal the identity label, headline, supporting copy, and primary action in sequence; 450–650ms with 60–100ms item staggering; decisive ease-out.
Purpose: reveal the hero media; trigger: initial load after the headline begins; affected relationship: bring media into its existing frame with a small directional shift; 500–700ms; smooth ease-out.

Purpose: clarify service and news groups; trigger: each visual group approaching the viewport; affected relationship: reveal related items in a short sequence without moving the whole section; 450–650ms with total staggering capped at 240ms; soft ease-out.
Purpose: confirm direct control input; trigger: hover, focus, press, or selection; affected relationship: change control color, outline, or position slightly; 120–200ms; responsive easing.

Purpose: communicate disclosure state; trigger: disclosure activation; affected relationship: expand or collapse its panel with a matching indicator change; 160–220ms; balanced ease-in-out, with equivalent controls under reduced motion.
avoid: Scroll-jacking, perpetual motion, or repeated reveal animations
Hiding content when scripts fail or reduced motion is enabled

voice.summary: Use direct, friendly Indonesian. Lead with service names, prices, quantities, schedules, and contact steps when verified project data provides them.
avoid: Promotional claims or measured results without project evidence.
Unnecessary jargon, inflated language, and sentences that obscure actions.
Invented availability, prices, schedules, achievements, or testimonials.
